	APPROVAL RECOMMENDATION: SPECIAL 10'S TEST MARKET INTRODUCTION	5/3/193

fac

The following requests approval to proceed with the test market introduction of SPECIAL 10's in Sales Section W-2 (less Nevada and Hawaii) beginning Sales Coverage #5; June 28, 1993 (Exhibit I details markets). Estimated 1993 test market costs are $1,301.1M (the recommended media plan will circulate under separate cover for approval).

BACKGROUND

Buying Trends:

As the consumer buying trend continues to shift toward lower priced cigarettes, most recently the B&W segment, the opportunity to introduce a brand with low out-of-pocket expense has become viable:
